prompt: Generate a two-row by six-column transparent-background orthographic pixel-art atlas. Each row is a different exact race-circuit object: row 1 race start gantry from reference 1 (a small freestanding metal overhead start frame on two striped feet with three red signal lamps); row 2 blank race leaderboard from reference 2 (freestanding rectangular dark display board on two striped feet with three amber lamps). In each row, six cells are ordered FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Same world axes and physical dimensions across all views. Preserve source identity/materials and details. FRONT/REAR are broad faces showing the correct blank board or open gantry; TOP is straight overhead footprint of crossbar/frame and feet, not the front face; RIGHT/LEFT are narrow side elevations showing the legs/crossbar depth; BOTTOM shows only ground-contact foot undersides and frame underside, not an upright board. Transparent background, clear gutters, one complete subject per cell, centered and uncropped, no text, labels, grid, extra objects, no perspective or isometric camera. Do not add displays to the open gantry; do not add readable text to the blank board.
